Section 179q of Title 2 of the United States Code covers use of the seal of the National Film Registry. Title 2 covers Congress, and this section sits in the chapter on the Library of Congress. The hosted text is the version current in twenty twenty six. The seal marks films that hold a place in the registry.

No person may knowingly share or show to the public a version of a film that bears the seal if the film is not in the registry. The ban covers any copy in any format of such a film. The seal described in a linked section is the mark at issue. Misuse of the mark is thus treated as a legal wrong.
